name: home-design-platform
description: 2D editable home design platform with read-only 3D preview

scripts.build: npm run build -w @home-design/plan-schema && npm run build -w @home-design/api && npm run build -w @home-design/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @home-design/plan-schema && npm run typecheck -w @home-design/api && npm run typecheck -w @home-design/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @home-design/plan-schema && npm run test -w @home-design/api && npm run test -w @home-design/web
